relations: The lower left pointing hand withdraws downward and exits the frame, leaving only the upper holding hand visible.
The lit candle's flame flickers continuously, altering its height and shape within the tall clear glass holder.
The mirror and candle assembly shifts slightly across the scene, maintaining the vertical offset of the reflected flame.
caption: A lit candle stands in a tall clear glass holder with a blue base on a white tiled floor, set before a white tiled wall and a large vertical mirror. A hand at the upper-left edge grips the top of the mirror and holds it steady, with only slight positional shifts, while the mirror returns a reflected image of the candle so that two flame shapes appear vertically offset. The flame flickers continuously, changing height and shape. A second hand at the lower left keeps an index finger extended toward the candle and mirror, moving and blurring as it points. That pointing hand then withdraws downward and leaves view, after which the upper holding hand is the only hand in view. The candle and the visible mirror edge shift slightly across the scene.
